comments.author: Simon
comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking Part 2: describe a skill
comments.text:
Hi Zesty, It's best not to hesitate in part 1 - just say the first thing you think of. In part 3, you could start with something like "Well, I think..." to buy a bit of time. Don't try to buy more time than that.

Have a look at this lesson too: http://ielts-simon.com/ielts-help-and-english-pr/2011/08/ielts-speaking-advice-get-to-the-point.html
